false_positive_patterns.security_media_domain_misidentified_as_i: Security-media, vendor, or reference hosts retained as IoCs when the source post discussed an advisory or third-party analysis rather than attacker-controlled infrastructure.
false_positive_patterns.poc_announcement_misclassified_as_exploi: PoC or disclosure discussion elevated to active exploitation without sufficient corroboration.
false_positive_patterns.news_article_without_direct_attack_confi: News-only summary without a directly actionable threat signal.
false_positive_patterns.reposted_ti_report_treated_as_new_incide: Reposted threat-intelligence item treated as a new incident.

major_quality_issue_patterns.severity_over_assignment_in_single_sourc: Severity over-assigned in a single-source report.
major_quality_issue_patterns.other_major_quality_issues: Other major quality issue (duplicate or split cluster).

false_negative_patterns.hacktivist_target_list_minimal_ioc_diver: Hacktivist target list with minimal IoC diversity.
false_negative_patterns.emerging_threat_with_insufficient_corrob: Emerging threat with insufficient corroborating evidence.

quality_audit_design: For each sampled report three binary decisions by two analysts: report-level false positive, unsupported IoC issue, major quality issue; analyst_disagreements counts decisions where the analysts differed.

label_evidence.security_media_domain_misidentified_as_i: the report lists a security-media, vendor or reference host among its IoCs (values in reference_hosts_listed_as_iocs)
label_evidence.poc_announcement_misclassified_as_exploi: the report describes PoC or exploit code and exploitation without any indicator
label_evidence.news_article_without_direct_attack_confi: the report summarises news coverage with no indicator and its summary reports no confirmed attack
label_evidence.reposted_ti_report_treated_as_new_incide: the report text describes a repost of earlier reporting
label_evidence.unsupported_ioc_issue: every IoC of the report carries LOW confidence
label_evidence.severity_over_assignment_in_single_sourc: HIGH or CRITICAL severity with a single source post
label_evidence.other_major_quality_issues: the report shares its title with another report (split cluster)
